simple.meaning: יִשְׂרְאֵלִית (Yisrᵉʼêlîyth) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Jisreelitess or female descendant of Jisrael.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יִשְׂרְאֵלִית (H3482) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Leviticus 24:10, with occurrences in Leviticus.

occurrences.englishText: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
